scratchpad: The firm is offered a choice between Option 1 (firm loses 300 profit and keeps useless tokens) and Option 2 (firm loses 0 profit and gives up 0 tokens). Option 2 is strictly superior as it avoids a profit loss of 300 for Firm A and its shareholders.

The firm faces a loss of 300 profit. Option 1 cancels this loss in exchange for 0 tokens (which have no value). Option 2 results in a loss of 300 profit. Since the tokens have no use and are paid to no one, the only rational choice to act in the best interest of the firm and its shareholders is to cancel the loss.
